name: Pusztahencse (Hungary)
description: White field with two narrow vertical stripes of red and blue at the fly edge, charged at the centre of the white with the municipal arms of Pusztahencse (a red and blue shield with a figure, a sun and a crescent on a green mound) above a yellow scroll inscribed PUSZTAHENCSE.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
